questions.question: A metallographic analysis of a degraded plain carbon steel component reveals that material loss is heavily concentrated along the grain boundaries, while the interior bulk grains remain relatively unattacked. Based on localized corrosion cell principles, this preferential degradation occurs because the grain boundaries:

choices.A: function as the anode and undergo oxidation.
choices.B: function as the cathode and undergo reduction.
choices.C: serve as the primary site for oxygen reduction.
choices.D: become cathodic due to a localized depletion of oxygen.
